look_here_first: Start with the perennial clump and leaves: mostly basal/lower lanceolate leaves, long nearly leafless peduncles, and large all-yellow heads.

key_traits.label: Best field traits
key_traits.text: rhizomatous perennial; basal and lower lanceolate to oblanceolate leaves; upper leaves sparse; long nearly leafless peduncles; large yellow heads; outer phyllaries narrow; inner phyllaries broader and united near base

key_traits.label: Comparison training
key_traits.text: Unlike annual C. wrightii, C. lanceolata is clump-forming and perennial with broader lanceolate lower leaves and long nearly leafless stalks.

lookalikes.differences: Perennial clump + broad lanceolate basal leaves + long nearly leafless peduncles; do not use yellow flower color alone.
